title: Terminal to agent to SDK: the honua CLI imports and publishes, the MCP proxy renders and buffers it, the Python SDK reads the job
promise: Data an operator imports and publishes with the honua CLI is what an agent reads, renders and analyses through the installed MCP proxy, and the job the agent starts is readable with its result through the Python SDK.

steps.description: Upload the fixture's GeoJSON polygon file through the typed admin CLI; the server imports exactly the fixture's features into a table.
Publish the table the import reported as a new service and polygon layer.
Read the CLI-published layer through the proxy; its polygon preserves the fixture envelope's ring, and its gid and name equal the fixture.
Render the CLI-published layer; sample pixels inside the fixture polygon are painted and those outside are transparent.
Buffer the polygon the proxy read by the fixture distance (a Geoprocess geometry.buffer step); the server accepts a job.
Read the agent's job by its id through the Python SDK until it is terminal; it succeeded.
Read the job's result through the Python SDK; the ring is the fixture polygon's buffer at the fixture distance, vertices and edges.
